description: List a company's SEC EDGAR filings (most recent first), optionally filtered by form type and filed-date range. Paginate with cursor/limit, or set max_items to auto-collect across pages in one call. Returns filing metadata and accession numbers; pass an accession to stocks_filing for its document list, or to stocks_sections / stocks_section for its extracted text.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's meta.next_cursor.

max_items.description: If set, auto-paginate across pages and return up to this many items (ignores cursor).

name: stocks_filings
title: List filings
